stories.title: Kate Middleton wears Gaurav Gupta in New Delhi
stories.summary: The Princess of Wales concluded her three-day visit to India by wearing a custom plum pantsuit by designer Gaurav Gupta for a meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The choice continued a series of wardrobe selections intended to spotlight homegrown Indian fashion designers during the royal tour.

stories.title: Princess of Wales concludes India tour in Gaurav Gupta
stories.summary: The Princess of Wales ended her India visit in a custom deep-plum pantsuit by designer Gaurav Gupta. The ensemble, featuring a single-button blazer and wide-leg trousers, was worn for an audience with Prime Minister Narendra Modi to showcase Indian fashion on the world stage.

stories.title: Kate Middleton Wraps Up India Visit In Custom Gaurav Gupta Suit, Meets PM Modi - News18
Princess of Wales spotlights Indian designers
stories.summary: During their three-day visit to India, the Prince and Princess of Wales attended the Earthshot Prize awards and met Prime Minister Narendra Modi. To mark the final engagement in New Delhi, the Princess wore a suit by designer Gaurav Gupta, continuing her practice of wearing local designers.

stories.title: Fashion Designer Siddartha Tytler Brings India's OG Models Back To The Ramp For 25th Anniversary Show - News18
TIME100 Next India list features fashion designers
stories.summary: The inaugural TIME100 Next India list identifies 100 individuals shaping the country's future, including designers Masaba Gupta, Padma Yangchan and Diya Joukani. The list highlights diverse approaches to the industry, ranging from print empires to the revival of traditional Ladakhi dress and social media-driven runway concepts.

stories.title: Sharvari On Career Highs, Breaking Style Rules And Dreaming Bigger | Grazia India
stories.summary: Here's a sneak peek into what unfolded at our August-September cover shoot We sat down with Sharvari to chat about an exciting new chapter in her career, finding confidence in the love coming her way and taking more risks with fashion. From navigating the demands of different days to embracing

stories.title: Kay Beauty wins PETA India award
stories.summary: Katrina Kaif's beauty brand, Kay Beauty, received the Best Vegan Makeup award at PETA India's 2026 Vegan Fashion Awards. The brand, co-founded with Nykaa, reported revenue growth from 240 crore in FY25 to 350 crore in FY26. The awards recognize brands eliminating animal products.

stories.title: Aishwarya Rai’s Cannes Gown To Katrina Kaif’s Kay Beauty: Who Won Big At PETA India 2026 Awards? - News18
Pratima Pandey collection draws from Kathakali
stories.summary: Designer Pratima Pandey showcased a collection at LFWxFDCI inspired by the visual language of Kathakali. Using silk chanderi tissue, kantha and sujani embroidery, the pieces explore movement and gesture through sculptural silhouettes. The designer stated the collection uses the spirit of the theatrical form to explore storytelling.

stories.title: Day and Age label explores gender-fluid fashion
stories.summary: The label Day and Age won the NIF Global GenNext award for its collection Neither This Nor That. Designers Shreya Parasrampuria and Sharan Adka used vintage Kantha quilts and mythical hybrid creatures to challenge traditional gender definitions. The collection explores identities that exist between worlds.

stories.title: Aisshpra Gems & Jewels adds four showrooms in a single day, takes retail network to 20 stores - The Retail Jeweller Indi
Fear of God releases tenth collection
stories.summary: Designer Jerry Lorenzo has introduced TEN, the tenth collection for Fear of God. Developed in Milan and Los Angeles, the designer described the timing as providential. The collection combines tailoring with vintage-inspired sportswear, moving away from the cleanliness associated with his previous work in Paris.

stories.title: Dsquared2 presents pre-fall 2027 collection
stories.summary: Dean and Dan Caten designed a rebel aristocrat wardrobe for the Dsquared2 pre-fall collection. The line features military uniforms, punk references and tailored pieces. The designers incorporated paint-splattered workwear and hybridized blazers, utilizing callbacks to previous collections as a starting point for the new designs.

stories.title: Dsquared2 pre-fall 2027 menswear collection
stories.summary: The Dsquared2 pre-fall menswear collection by Dean and Dan Caten features military uniforms, punk-inspired leather jackets and ripped denim. The designers juxtaposed rigorous tailoring with rocker aesthetics and paint-splattered workwear. The collection relies on recurring design elements from the brand's history to define its rebel aristocrat theme.

stories.title: Tom Ford releases resort 2027 menswear
stories.summary: Tom Ford has released his latest resort collection. The designer, who previously stated in interviews that he views himself as an equal opportunity objectifier of both men and women, continues to navigate cultural standards regarding the depiction of male nudity in fashion imagery.

stories.title: Tom Ford resort 2027 collection
stories.summary: Tom Ford has debuted his resort 2027 collection. The designer has previously noted his approach to objectification in fashion, arguing that cultural norms permit the exploitation of women more readily than men. A decade later, the brand continues to present its aesthetic on the global stage.

stories.title: Princess Charlene and daughter coordinate outfits
stories.summary: Princess Charlene of Monaco and her daughter Princess Gabriella wore matching white outfits for the principality's National Day celebrations. The pair appeared alongside Prince Albert II and Prince Jacques, who wore ceremonial military regalia. The event marked the 15th anniversary of the royal couple's marriage.

stories.title: Hunter Schafer wears PVC trenchcoat to Blade Runner event
stories.summary: Hunter Schafer attended a photo call for Blade Runner 2099 in a clear PVC trenchcoat from Prada. The look was intended to reference the costume history of the film franchise dating back to 1982. The coat served as the hero element of the ensemble.

stories.title: Eva Longoria and Andie MacDowell attend L’Oréal event
stories.summary: L’Oréal Paris ambassadors Eva Longoria and Andie MacDowell appeared together at the brand’s Women of Worth event in Los Angeles. Both actresses wore glowy, skin-forward makeup looks for the occasion. Longoria has served as a representative for the company since 2005.

stories.title: Kylie Jenner and Timothée Chalamet attend Lakers game
stories.summary: Kylie Jenner and Timothée Chalamet sat courtside at the Crypto.com Arena to watch the Los Angeles Lakers play the Utah Jazz. The pair were observed chatting and laughing throughout the game. The Lakers lost the match 109 to 97.

stories.title: Zara Tindall attends Tusk Conservation Awards
stories.summary: Zara Tindall attended the Tusk Conservation Awards at Raffles London at The OWO earlier this month. The royal wore a sapphire-blue dress to the event, which was attended by Prince William and other family members. The evening was described as a rare royal gathering.

stories.title: Sara Tendulkar and Saaniya Chandhok attend fashion event
stories.summary: Sara Tendulkar and Saaniya Chandhok appeared at Vogue India’s Forces of Fashion 2026 event in Mumbai. The two were photographed on the green carpet at the event, which was presented in association with Tanishq Jewellery. The pair wore ensembles by designer Anamika Khanna.

stories.title: Vogue India Forces of Fashion 2026 event held in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Vogue India Forces of Fashion 2026 event took place in Mumbai. Attendees included Ananya, Mrunal Thakur, Sara Tendulkar, and Manish Malhotra. The event featured various figures from the Indian film and fashion industries.

stories.title: Union Home Minister Amit Shah calls for Indian leadership of lab-grown diamond value chain - The Retail Jeweller India
Gold Jewellery Can Pass Purity Tests and Still Contain Less Gold, Probe Finds Shocking Results - NDTV Profit
Gold near 14-month low: Muthoot Finance, Manappuram, IIFL Finance shares fall, Kalyan Jewellers gains - Moneycontrol.com
Gold loan company shares decline as metal prices drop
stories.summary: Shares of Muthoot Finance, Manappuram Finance, and IIFL Finance fell by up to 2.6 percent on Thursday. The decline followed a drop in gold prices to near 14-month lows amid expectations of further US interest-rate hikes. Kalyan Jewellers shares saw a gain.

stories.title: Gold's sharp fall revives wedding demand, but poses risks for jewellers - Moneycontrol.com
Gold prices remain near 14-month lows
stories.summary: Gold prices in India stayed near 14-month lows on Thursday ahead of the wedding season. The 24-karat gold price was reported at 130,050 rupees per 10 grams, a decrease of 410 rupees from the previous session. Spot gold is also trading lower in international markets.

stories.title: Gold prices fall for seventh consecutive session
stories.summary: The price of 24-carat gold fell to 130,690 rupees per 10 grams on Thursday, a decrease of 2,570 rupees from Wednesday. This marks the seventh straight day of price declines for the metal. The fall was the second sharpest since November 5.

stories.title: Festive gold sales value increases
stories.summary: Retailers reported a 15 to 25 percent year-on-year increase in gold sales value during the Dhanteras-Diwali period. The World Gold Council attributed the growth to a decline in gold prices since mid-October. Buying was reported as broad-based across regions.

stories.title: Jewellers report festive growth despite price fluctuations
stories.summary: Jewellers reported double-digit growth in sales value during the festive season. While prices were higher than the previous year, retailers noted that volume remained similar or slightly higher. Categories including gold, diamonds, and silver saw broad growth across various showrooms.

stories.title: A Season of Sparkle: The Estate of Abbe Lane Leads John Moran's December Jewelry Auctions - StreetInsider
Jacqueline Rabun Expands an Influential Jewelry Collection - The New York Times
Gold prices drop as wedding season approaches
stories.summary: The price of 24-carat gold fell by approximately 1,180 rupees to 129,980 rupees per 10 grams on Thursday. Gold has decreased by roughly 12,000 rupees over the last seven trading days. Silver prices also declined, falling by 2,160 rupees per kilogram.

stories.title: Polo Ralph Lauren hosts poolside bag launch
stories.summary: Polo Ralph Lauren celebrated its new Blaze bag with a poolside lunch at the Sunset Tower Hotel. Named after the white marking on a horse’s face, the bag launched as part of the Fall 2026 collection. It has already become a staple in Charlotte Lawrence’s rotation.

stories.title: Chanel introduces another unconventional shoe
stories.summary: Designers are increasingly favoring unorthodox footwear, with celebrities showing a marked interest in the trend. Following clear-PVC dress shoes and leather heel caps, a new contender has entered the market from Chanel. The season is defined by footwear that prompts onlookers to do a double take.

stories.title: Taylor Swift changes jewelry for CMA Awards
stories.summary: Taylor Swift attended the 60th Annual Country Music Association Awards in Nashville to promote her latest song. She performed and presented an award while wearing three different outfits and three distinct sets of jewelry, including custom Lorraine Schwartz earrings set with 55 carats of diamonds and tourmalines.

stories.title: Taylor Swift wears 55 carats of diamonds at CMAs
stories.summary: Taylor Swift wore canary-yellow and white diamond drop earrings paired with a Paraíba tourmaline ring from jeweler Lorraine Schwartz at the CMA Awards. The look was completed with an Oscar de la Renta gown and her own engagement ring. The tourmalines provided a contrast to the diamonds.

stories.title: G-SHOCK and HIDDEN.NY release collaborative watch
stories.summary: G-SHOCK has partnered with creative collective HIDDEN.NY for a special-edition timepiece. Based on the GM-2100 series, the watch features a silver finish and green accents. The design aims to pay homage to the street culture and nostalgia of the 1990s and 2000s.

stories.title: Hypebeast magazine celebrates issue launch in NYC
stories.summary: Hypebeast Magazine held a launch party for its latest issue in New York City featuring cover star Xaviersobased. The event included a pop-up signing and a live performance at a local magazine shop. Fans gathered hours before the artist arrived to begin the celebration.

stories.title: NORQAIN updates Independence skeleton watch
stories.summary: NORQAIN is refreshing its Independence collection with a redesigned stainless steel bracelet featuring a micro-adjust clasp and narrower lugs. The update includes a new Skeleton 40mm model with a translucent Arctic Blue dial. The brand aims for a more cohesive silhouette between case and bracelet.

stories.title: Jordan Brand previews Masters-themed golf shoe
stories.summary: Jordan Brand is expanding its golf lineup with the Air Jordan 11 Low Golf, featuring a green-and-white colorway. The design is tied directly to the Augusta National tournament. The sneaker is scheduled for an official release in April 2027 as part of the brand's fairway collection.

stories.title: Oris releases Doraemon-themed watch
stories.summary: Oris has launched a limited edition Big Crown Pointer Date watch featuring the Japanese manga character Doraemon. The timepiece includes a light blue dial, red minute track, and yellow hands. A flying Doraemon is engraved on the caseback of the 1,000-piece edition.

stories.title: Horse-themed jewelry gains popularity
stories.summary: The jewelry industry is leaning into horse-inspired motifs, ranging from horseshoes to stirrups. While these designs have historical roots in Victorian-era jewelry, they are currently seeing a resurgence. Celebrities have begun incorporating these pieces into their public appearances during the current Year of the Fire Horse.

stories.title: Holiday Jewelry Gifts for Every Kind of Main Character - Byrdie
Holiday gift trends for women
stories.summary: Retailers are highlighting various gift categories for the holiday season, including beauty and jewelry products. In-person shopping is seeing a revival, with Gen Z identified as a leading demographic for the trend. Various platforms are currently promoting countdown calendars and curated gift lists.

stories.title: Fine Merino prices rise in Australian wool market
stories.summary: Australian wool auctions saw a recovery in local terms, though US-dollar equivalents fell for some categories. Fine and medium Merino prices rose, while crossbred wool prices declined. The market remains sensitive to processor demand, and buyers are adjusting their planning to account for shifting micron specifications.

stories.title: Egypt sees growth in garment exports
stories.summary: Egypt's garment exports rose to $1.1 billion in the first half of 2026, while Turkish exports declined. Egypt expects $1 billion in foreign investment this year. The data suggests an increasingly connected production network rather than a mass exit of manufacturers from the Turkish market.

stories.title: President Murmu to attend National Handloom Day
stories.summary: President Droupadi Murmu will serve as the chief guest at the 12th National Handloom Day celebrations on August 7, 2026. The event at the Rashtrapati Bhavan Cultural Centre will honor India's handloom heritage and recognize the contributions of the weaving community to the national economy.

stories.title: North India cotton yarn market remains sluggish
stories.summary: Cotton yarn markets in North India are experiencing a decline in prices amid falling fiber costs. Demand for recycled yarn in Panipat remains slow, with traders hoping for a cold wave to increase interest in winter clothing. Prices in Ludhiana eased across various counts and varieties.

stories.title: Indian textile exporters look to new markets
stories.summary: Indian textile and apparel exporters are diversifying their overseas markets to reduce dependence on the US amid tariff uncertainty. Industry representatives are utilizing free trade agreements to expand into the UK, Europe, Australia, the UAE, and Japan while maintaining existing business relationships.

stories.title: Dr. Vinayak Ogale named head of technical textiles mission
stories.summary: The Ministry of Textiles has appointed Dr. Vinayak Ogale as Mission Director of the National Technical Textiles Mission. Dr. Ogale brings two decades of experience in research and development, including previous roles at 3M India and Saint-Gobain, to the government role focused on innovation and product commercialization.

stories.title: Australian wool market gains ahead of Christmas auction recess
stories.summary: Australia's wool market continued its recovery in Week 21, with the EMI rising 16 cents to 1,738 Au cents per kilogram. National offerings reached 27,814 bales, though the pass-in rate climbed to 11.2 per cent. Supply is forecast at 31,000 bales for the final week before the recess.

stories.title: How Africa's Baoule textiles are revolutionizing fashion - NewsBytes
Government plans integrated textile census to build database
stories.summary: The government has initiated an Integrated Textile Census to create a comprehensive database of India's textile value chain. The project aims to unify household and establishment-based production units under a single digital platform. The previous census was conducted by the Ministry of Textiles.

stories.title: Why we can't innovate our way out of fashion overproduction
stories.summary: Industry leaders recently gathered at a textile recovery summit to discuss technologies for sorting and repairing discarded clothing. Despite the focus on new systems to handle the mounting tide of waste, brands continue to face pressure to prove actual progress in reducing the volume sent to landfills.

stories.title: Poundland sale becomes matter for parliament
stories.summary: Poundland faces a 26 November deadline before its creditor protection expires. While management claims the business is profitable, the possibility of a break-up has prompted protests from staff and intervention from the prime minister. MPs have now called in the European boss of the prospective buyer.

stories.title: Egypt targets EU apparel market growth
stories.summary: Egypt and the EU have signed a pact covering circularity, digital product passports, and greener production. EU clothing imports from Egypt rose 29.1 per cent in 2025, with the country targeting garment exports of several billion dollars by 2030. Suppliers are now being assessed for regulatory compliance.

stories.title: Irish folklore-inspired look wins at sustainable fashion competition
stories.summary: A design inspired by Irish folklore won Enable Ireland's The Final Find 2026 competition in Dublin. The event challenged contestants to transform charity shop finds into runway-worthy looks. Now in its second year, the competition aims to spotlight circular fashion and support vital disability services.

stories.title: Irish folklore-inspired look wins at sustainable fashion competition
Faux fur coats see stylish and sustainable update
stories.summary: Fur remains a recurring presence on autumn and winter runways, though industry standards on material sourcing have shifted. While major labels like Chanel and Prada have banned animal fur, the question of how to wear the texture remains complicated. Plant-based alternatives are now being marketed as the solution.

stories.title: Why can claims about sustainable fashion be difficult to evaluate? - Britannica
Vegan fashion market sees growth in sustainable innovation
stories.summary: The vegan fashion market is expanding as brands prioritize ethical production and animal-free materials. Consumers are increasingly shifting toward plant-based, recycled, and other innovative alternatives to leather, fur, wool, and silk. The industry is positioning these materials as a response to the environmental impact of conventional production.

stories.title: Vegan fashion market highlights growth opportunities
stories.summary: The vegan fashion market is projected to grow from 498.2 billion dollars in 2025 to 540.2 billion dollars in 2026. This expansion is driven by changing consumer values and the adoption of cruelty-free materials. The industry expects this rapid growth trend to continue through 2030.

stories.title: Why We Can’t Innovate Our Way Out of Fashion Overproduction
stories.summary: Earlier this month, I had a front-row seat to the future of textile recovery on the Innovation Stage at the Textile Recovery Summit in San Diego. I served as one of the judges alongside leaders from product stewardship, investment, and advanced manufacturing. The pitch competition was a compressed version of

stories.title: The economics of fast fashion
stories.summary: Fast fashion relies on low costs, rapid trend response, and high sales volumes to maintain its business model. The industry currently faces hidden costs from waste, returns, and emissions. Experts suggest that AI-assisted forecasting and circular practices could eventually shift the sector toward smarter production methods.

stories.title: Miu Miu sales growth slows after viral period
stories.summary: After a period of rapid growth driven by viral product releases, Miu Miu's sales have normalized. The label recorded a 2.4 per cent increase in Q1 2026, compared to a 60 per cent increase the previous year. Prada Group's CEO attributed the slowdown to a disrupted market.

stories.title: Inside Gap's fashiontainment era
stories.summary: Gap Inc. has appointed its first chief entertainment officer to lead a new marketing strategy across its brands. The company aims to reclaim relevance by immersing fashion in culture, including sports, music, and gaming. The strategy is led by executives recently imported from the entertainment and toy industries.

stories.title: Procter & Gamble Targets Up to $10 Billion in Savings - The Business of Fashion
Tod’s Nears €400 Million Debt Refinancing Backed by Owners - The Business of Fashion
General Pants Co Enters Voluntary Administration - The Business of Fashion
Bath & Body Works Raises Annual Forecast, Beats Third-Quarter Expectations - The Business of Fashion
Mulberry’s Reset Gains Steam Ahead of Key Holiday Test - The Business of Fashion
JD Sports cuts profit outlook as sales fall
stories.summary: JD Sports has lowered its profit forecast for the second time in four months following a 2.6 percent drop in third-quarter like-for-like sales. The retailer now expects annual profit before tax of 700 million to 750 million pounds. The previous guidance reached up to 800 million pounds.

stories.title: Walmart Nudges Up Annual Forecasts Ahead of Crucial Holiday Season - The Business of Fashion
Nike CEO Tries to Rally Staff After Pitch Underwhelms Investors - The Business of Fashion
L’Oréal leads bid for Armani stake
stories.summary: L’Oréal is reportedly leading a group of investors seeking a 15 percent stake in the Italian fashion house Armani. EssilorLuxottica is expected to join the deal, while LVMH has withdrawn from discussions. The parties have yet to agree on a final valuation for the company.

stories.title: L'Oreal looks to buy 10% Armani stake, LVMH out of the race, report says - Reuters
Kering hires Nike executive for pricing role
stories.summary: Kering has appointed former Nike director Francisco Ochando as group director of pricing. The move follows the company's acknowledgement that aggressive price increases negatively impacted sales volumes. The group is now making pricing a central component of its turnaround strategy for brands including Gucci and Balenciaga.

stories.title: General Pants collapse fuels retail crisis fears - Michael West Media
Zara reopens its flagship store on New York’s Fifth Avenue after seven months of renovation - FashionNetwork - The World
Zara reopens Fifth Avenue flagship
Zara reopens Fifth Avenue flagship in US expansion
stories.summary: Zara has completed a seven-month renovation of its flagship store at 660 Fifth Avenue in New York. The company plans over 20 store openings, renovations, and relocations across the United States in 2027. Inditex is placing the country at the center of its current growth strategy.

stories.title: Zara reopens Melbourne flagship with new design
stories.summary: Zara has introduced a global store design concept to its Bourke Street Mall location in Melbourne following a renovation. The updated site features a lighter facade and new omnichannel services. Shoppers were observed queuing to enter the store upon its reopening this week.

stories.title: Zara Home decorates London store for holidays
stories.summary: Zara Home has updated its Duke of York Square store in London with a festive display. The interior now features model trains and an animated dollshouse containing miniature animal characters. The retailer describes the transformation as a magical Christmas wonderland.

stories.title: Zara Home expands Nicosia store
stories.summary: Zara Home has reopened its location at the Mall of Cyprus in Nicosia following an expansion to 412 square meters. The store interior uses natural mortar and fine wood to simulate different rooms of a home. The layout begins in the bedroom area and connects to children's collections.

stories.title: Moda Operandi co-founder launches AI design platform
stories.summary: Aslaug Magnusdottir has launched Tinker Tailor, an AI-supported platform that allows users to design made-to-order garments. The service offers AI guidance for custom creations or access to collections from featured designers. Finished items are delivered directly to the customer.

stories.title: Áslaug Magnúsdóttir Relaunches Tinker Tailor as AI Creator Platform - The Business of Fashion
Tony Fadell looks to modernize textile production with AI
stories.summary: Tony Fadell is applying AI to fashion supply chains, which Smartex.AI CEO Max Easton describes as splintered and reliant on manual labor. The industry currently relies on workers watching rolls of cloth for defects. Modernizing the 1970s-era warehouse workflow is expected to save H&M $100 million annually.

stories.title: Mall of America introduces AI concierge Mallie
stories.summary: Mall of America has launched an AI-backed digital assistant named Mallie. The tool is designed to help shoppers plan and personalize their visits to the shopping and entertainment complex. It is currently available to assist visitors navigating the large facility.

stories.title: Target reports early success with Ask Target AI assistant
stories.summary: Target is testing a generative AI shopping assistant called Ask Target. CEO Michael Fiddelke says the beta program is currently driving sales. The retailer is using the tool to assist customers with their shopping experience.

stories.title: Smartex.ai unveils AI fabric ecosystem with Tony Fadell as chairman - Fibre2Fashion
Macy Grimshaw wins H&M Design Award 2026
stories.summary: The H&M Design Award has returned after a six-year hiatus. Central Saint Martins graduate Macy Grimshaw won the 2026 prize, receiving €150,000 and a year-long mentorship. Her collection, which features leather and silk, will be produced and sold by H&M in autumn 2027.

stories.title: Macy Grimshaw wins H&M Design Award 2026 - FashionNetwork - The World's Fashion Business News
Macy Grimshaw of London's Central Saint Martins wins H&M Design Award 2026
stories.summary: Loading... Macy Grimshaw, a student at Central Saint Martins, University of the Arts London, has won the H&M Design Award 2026. As winner, Grimshaw receives a 150,000 euro endowment and a year-long mentorship, and H&M will produce and sell her collection. Each of the seven other finalists receives 10,000 euros.

stories.title: MACY GRIMSHAW WINS THE H&M DESIGN AWARD 2026 - H&M
The H&M Design Award for 2026 goes to Macy Grimshaw - FashionNetwork India
The H&M Design Award for 2026 goes to Macy Grimshaw - FashionNetwork USA
Style Union parent raises Rs 485 crore for national expansion
stories.summary: Nexon Omniverse, parent of value fashion retailer Style Union, has raised Rs 485 crore in a Series E round led by Venturi Partners. The company plans to use the capital to scale its physical store network from its southern base into western and northern India.

stories.title: Style Union raises Rs 485 crore at Rs 8,000 crore valuation
stories.summary: Value fashion retailer Style Union has raised Rs 485 crore in a Series E round, reportedly valuing the company at Rs 8,000 crore. With FY26 revenue exceeding Rs 1,150 crore, the valuation sits at roughly seven times sales. The retailer intends to compete with Zudio.

stories.title: Style Union expands store network with new funding
stories.summary: Nexon Omniverse has raised Rs 485 crore to expand its Style Union retail brand beyond southern India. The company grew from 41 stores in FY23 to 158 in FY26 and now operates about 200 outlets. The funding round includes a mix of primary and secondary capital.

stories.title: Style Union targets 450 stores by 2030
stories.summary: Nexon Omniverse has raised Rs 485 crore to accelerate the national expansion of its Style Union brand. The retailer plans to grow its network from 200 stores to 220 by March 2027, with a target of 450 locations by March 2030.

stories.title: Style Union raises Rs 485 crore in funding co-led by Venturi Partners, Elev8 Venture Partners - Moneycontrol.com
Style Union secures Rs 485 crore in Series E funding
stories.summary: Style Union parent Nexon Omniverse has raised Rs 485 crore in a Series E round led by Venturi Partners. The company plans to deploy the capital to expand its physical retail presence in new metros, aiming for 450 stores by March 2030.
